title: Zoom in: the CDN read path, from first miss to cache hit
caption: Immutable keys let every layer cache for a long time; an origin shield makes one origin GET serve every edge.

messages.label: GET /p/p_77/1080.webp
messages.note: The nearest edge has never seen this photo.

messages.label: miss → shield
messages.note: Edges ask one regional shield instead of all hitting the origin.

messages.label: GET photos/p_77/1080.webp
messages.note: One origin request, ~50 ms first byte.

messages.label: 200, max-age 1 year, immutable
messages.note: Safe because a changed photo gets a new key; this one never changes.

messages.label: 200 (cached at shield)
messages.note: Other edges in the region now hit the shield.

messages.label: 200 in ~80 ms
messages.note: Cached at the edge as well.

messages.label: GET /p/p_77/1080.webp
messages.note: Another viewer near the same edge.

messages.label: 200 HIT in ~10 ms
messages.note: No origin cost, no origin latency.

scenarios.name: Origin outage
scenarios.summary: The store's region has errors for 20 minutes: cached photos keep working, uncached ones fail.

messages.label: GET p_77/1080.webp
messages.note: A popular photo, cached but past its revalidation time.

messages.label: revalidate
messages.note: The shield asks the origin.

messages.label: GET
messages.note: The origin returns 503.

messages.label: stale copy (stale-if-error)
messages.note: Serving the last good copy beats an error for an immutable object.

messages.label: 200 (stale)
messages.note: The viewer doesn't notice.

messages.label: GET p_99/1080.webp (never cached)
messages.note: A brand-new photo.
Nothing to fall back on. A replicated second origin fixes this (see How it scales).

scenarios.name: Photo deleted
scenarios.summary: The owner deletes a photo, but edges keep serving it until their copy expires; privacy deletes need a purge.

messages.label: DELETE /photos/p_77
messages.note: The owner removes the photo.

messages.label: DELETE photos/p_77/*
messages.note: Original and renditions are gone from the store.

messages.label: GET p_77/1080.webp
messages.note: Someone opens an old link.

messages.label: 200 HIT
messages.note: The edge still has a copy that is valid for a year.

messages.label: purge p_77/*
messages.note: Fix: the delete also purges by key prefix or cache tag (seconds to minutes to propagate).

messages.label: GET p_77/1080.webp
messages.note: Same link after the purge.
Gone everywhere.

scenarios.name: Private album
scenarios.summary: Private photos use signed URLs: the edge checks the signature, and the cache key ignores it so all viewers share one copy.

messages.label: GET p_77/1080.webp?sig=…&exp=…
messages.note: The API handed out a URL signed for 1 hour.

messages.label: verify signature and expiry
messages.note: Done at the edge before any cache lookup.

messages.label: miss (cache key without sig)
messages.note: Different signatures for the same file share one cached object.

messages.label: GET (CDN's own credentials)
messages.note: The bucket is private; only the CDN may read it.
Cached once.

messages.label: GET p_77/1080.webp?sig=expired
messages.note: A link forwarded a day later.

messages.label: 403 expired
messages.note: Rejected even though the bytes are in the cache.
